ruleDefinitions.name: Windows Firewall Profile Disabled
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when a user disables the Windows Firewall via a Profile to help evade defense. Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Set\\-NetFirewallProfile\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-Enabled\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ False.*")) AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\ \\-All\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Public.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Domain.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Private.*")))
